The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer

--- This repository contains the open-source PR Agent Project. It is not the Qodo offering for open-source projects. PR-Agent is an open-source, AI-powered code review agent and a community-maintained legacy project of Qodo. It is distinct from Qodo's primary AI code review offering, which provides a feature-rich, context-aware experience. Qodo offers a free version for open-source projects and integrates seamlessly with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps for high-quality automated reviews. ## Sponsors PR-Agent is a community-maintained open-source project, with its ongoing development supported by our sponsors. If you'd like to support the project, consider [becoming a sponsor](https://github.com/sponsors/naorpeled).

🥇 Gold Sponsor

Free version of Qodo for open-source projects

## Table of Contents - [Getting Started](#getting-started) - [Why Use PR-Agent?](#why-use-pr-agent) - [Features](#features) - [See It in Action](#see-it-in-action) - [How It Works](#how-it-works) - [Data Privacy](#data-privacy) - [Contributing](#contributing) ## Getting Started > [!NOTE] > **Docker Hub namespace migration.** Releases `0.34.2` and later are published under [`pragent/pr-agent`](https://hub.docker.com/r/pragent/pr-agent). Older releases (up to and including `v0.31`) remain available at the legacy [`codiumai/pr-agent`](https://hub.docker.com/r/codiumai/pr-agent) namespace as a frozen archive — no new images are pushed there. Update any pinned `image:` / `docker pull` / `uses: docker://` references when upgrading to `0.34.2+`. ### 🚀 Quick Start for PR-Agent #### 1. GitHub Action (Recommended) Add automated PR reviews to your repository with a simple workflow file: ```yaml # .github/workflows/pr-agent.yml name: PR Agent on: pull_request: # PR-Agent skips synchronize by default. Include it in github_action_config.pr_actions # for auto commands, or enable github_action_config.handle_push_trigger for push_commands (takes precedence). types: [opened, synchronize] jobs: pr_agent_job: runs-on: ubuntu-latest permissions: contents: read issues: write pull-requests: write steps: - name: PR Agent action step uses: the-pr-agent/pr-agent@main env: OPENAI_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_KEY }} GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} ``` [Full GitHub Action setup guide](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/installation/github/#run-as-a-github-action) #### 2. CLI Usage (Local Development) Run PR-Agent locally on your repository: ```bash pip install "pr-agent[github]" export OPENAI__KEY=your_openai_key export GITHUB__USER_TOKEN=your_github_token pr-agent --pr_url https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123 review ``` Git provider SDKs are optional extras: install the one for your provider ([list](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/installation/locally/#using-pip-package)), or `pr-agent[all]` for every integration. [Complete CLI setup guide](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/usage-guide/automations_and_usage/#local-repo-cli) #### 3. Other Platforms - [GitLab webhook setup](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/installation/gitlab/) - [BitBucket app installation](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/installation/bitbucket/) - [Azure DevOps setup](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/installation/azure/) ## News and Updates Full notes for every release are on the [Releases page](https://github.com/the-pr-agent/pr-agent/releases). ## Why Use PR-Agent? ### 🎯 Built for Real Development Teams **Fast & Affordable**: Simple `/review` and `/ask` requests can use one LLM call; retries, fallbacks, and larger reviews may need more. **Handles Any PR Size**: Our [PR Compression strategy](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/core-abilities/compression_strategy/) effectively processes both small and large PRs **Highly Customizable**: JSON-based prompting allows easy customization of review categories and behavior via [configuration files](pr_agent/settings/configuration.toml) **Platform Agnostic**: - **Git Providers**: GitHub, GitLab, BitBucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea - **Deployment**: CLI, GitHub Actions, Docker, self-hosted, webhooks - **AI Models**: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, and any other model reachable through LiteLLM (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Databricks, OpenRouter, Ollama, and more) — see [Changing a model](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/usage-guide/changing_a_model/) **Open Source Benefits**: - Full control over your data and infrastructure - Customize prompts and behavior for your team's needs - No vendor lock-in - Community-driven development ## Features
See the current [feature and git provider support matrix](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/overview/supported_platforms/) in the PR-Agent documentation. ⚠️ `/help_docs` is temporarily disabled since `v0.36.1` pending a fix for a credential-exposure issue ([#2445](https://github.com/the-pr-agent/pr-agent/issues/2445)). [//]: # (- Support for additional git providers is described in [here](./docs/Full_environments.md)) ___ ## See It in Action

/describe

/review

/improve

### Usage Examples PR-Agent commands run as a comment on a PR or from the CLI. A few common ones: ```bash # Comment on a PR (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/…): /describe /review /ask "What does this PR change?" # free-text Q&A about the PR # Issue-scoped commands run on an issue instead of a PR: /similar_issue # find similar issues in the repository # Or locally via the CLI: pr-agent --pr_url review pr-agent --issue_url similar_issue ``` See the [Commands docs](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/commands/#usage-examples) for the full list of commands with example commands, and each command's page for screenshots and options.
## How It Works The following diagram illustrates PR-Agent commands and their flow: ## Data Privacy ### Self-hosted PR-Agent - If you host PR-Agent with your OpenAI API key, it is between you and OpenAI. You can read their API data privacy policy here: https://openai.com/enterprise-privacy ## Contributing To contribute to the project, get started by reading our [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/the-pr-agent/pr-agent/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). For local verification, run `PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest` from the repository root; it discovers the unit-test suite under `tests/unittest` by default. End-to-end tests under `tests/e2e_tests` require provider credentials and should be invoked explicitly, for example `PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest tests/e2e_tests/test_github_app.py`. ## Big News for PR-Agent PR-Agent has a new home! After years of building this tool alongside the community, Qodo has donated PR-Agent to the open-source community - and we couldn't be more excited about what comes next. The project now lives in the PR-Agent org on GitHub, is fully community-owned, and is open for contributions and additional maintainers. What else changed: - Docs moved to - [docs.pr-agent.ai](https://docs.pr-agent.ai/) - Qodo Merge (Qodo 1.0), the hosted URL, which was the enterprise version of PR-Agent, has been rebranded and evolved into Qodo (Qodo 2.0), a full AI code review platform. ## ❤️ Community This open-source release remains here as a community contribution from Qodo — the origin of modern AI-powered code collaboration. We’re proud to share it and inspire developers worldwide. The project now has its first external maintainer, Naor ([@naorpeled](https://github.com/naorpeled)), and is currently in the process of being donated to an open-source foundation.

releases.body:
## ⚠️ Breaking changes and upgrade notes

- **Host-only settings:** Repository `.pr_agent.toml` files can no longer override GitHub pacing and retry settings (`github.seconds_between_requests`, `github.seconds_between_writes`, `github.api_retries`, `github.ratelimit_retries`), `config.num_retries`, `azure_devops_server.agent_identity`, custom-label settings (`config.enable_custom_labels` and `[custom_labels]`), or `pr_code_suggestions.max_number_of_calls`. `config.num_retries` is capped at 10. Per-directory `.pr_agent.toml` files also cannot set `pr_code_suggestions.dual_publishing_score_threshold`. Move values you rely on to host configuration. (#4445, #4475, #4485, #4632, #4745)
- **Comment arguments:** `config.ai_timeout` and `pr_code_suggestions.max_number_of_calls` can no longer be set through command comments. (#4445)
- **Removed no-op settings:** `pr_code_suggestions.approve_pr_on_self_review` and `pr_code_suggestions.fold_suggestions_on_self_review` are removed from the shipped configuration. PR-Agent warns if they remain set; they never changed `/improve` behavior. (#4598)
- **Custom provider integrations:** Unused provider methods and capability names were removed. R

releases.name: v0.49.0
releases.body:
## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **GitHub polling needs an allowlist.** New host-only `github.polling_repositories = ["owner/repo", ...]`; empty (the default) ignores every notification, so polling deployments must set it (#4294).
- **Jira `project_keys = []` now disables lookups.** The default is now `["*"]`. If you set `[]` to mean "all projects", change it to `["*"]` or remove it (#4049).
- **`litellm.extra_headers` is host-only.** Repository `.pr_agent.toml` and comment arguments can no longer set it (#4287).
- **Default model is now `gpt-6.1-sol`** with `gpt-6-luna` as fallback (was `gpt-5.6` / `gpt-5.6-terra`). Pin `config.model` to keep the old one (#4088).
- **Langfuse SDK 4.18.0** needs self-hosted Langfuse 3.63.0+; use the `langfuse_otel` callback (#4343).
- **GitHub App token in Actions:** set `github.agent_login` to `<app-slug>[bot]` so PR-Agent recognises its own comments (#4329).

## ✨ Highlights

- `pr-agent doctor` preflights a deployment (#4321).
- `--json-output` for `/describe`, `/improve` and `/review` (#4265, #4227, #4226).

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

> [!WARNING]
> This release changes several defaults and makes more settings host-only. Check each item below against your deployment before upgrading.

- **`pip install pr-agent` no longer installs the git provider SDKs** ([#3679](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3679)): PyGithub, python-gitlab, atlassian-python-api, the Azure DevOps SDKs, boto3, giteapy, the Google Cloud SDKs and a2a-sdk moved to the `github`, `gitlab`, `bitbucket`, `azure`, `codecommit`, `gitea`, `google` and `mosaico` extras. Install the ones you use, for example `pip install "pr-agent[github]"`, or `pr-agent[all]` for the previous set. The Docker images already install `all`.
- **Docker service images run as a non-root user** ([#3910](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3910)): the webhook, app, polling and Mosaico targets run as UID/GID `10001` with `HOME=/home/pragent`. Mounted secrets must be readable by that user, output and database directories must be writable, and home-relative mounts should move to `/home/pragent`. releases.name: v0.47.0
releases.body:
## ⚠️ Important Changes

- **Gitea webhooks now require a secret** ([#3637](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3637)): with `gitea.webhook_secret` unset, the Gitea app rejects every webhook with HTTP 403 instead of accepting it unsigned. Set the secret on the Gitea webhook and in your config before upgrading.
- **The GitHub Action fails on tool errors** ([#3712](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3712)): a tool failure that used to be logged and swallowed now fails the Action. Set `github_action_config.fail_on_tool_errors = false` to keep the old green behaviour.
- **Comment commands need a leading `/` on GitLab, Bitbucket and Bitbucket Server** ([#3769](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3769)): a comment only runs a tool when it starts with a slash command, so plain comments that mention one no longer trigger anything.
- **`extra_config_url` is host-only** ([#3638](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3638)): a repository's `.pr_agent.toml` can no longer set it. Configure it on the host instead, for example with `PR_AGENT_EXTRA_CONFIG_URL`.

The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer

This repository contains the open-source PR Agent Project. It is not the Qodo offering for open-source projects.

PR-Agent is an open-source, AI-powered code review agent and a community-maintained legacy project of Qodo. It is distinct from Qodo's primary AI code review offering, which provides a feature-rich, context-aware experience. Qodo offers a free version for open-source projects and integrates seamlessly with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps for high-quality automated reviews.

Sponsors

PR-Agent is a community-maintained open-source project, with its ongoing development supported by our sponsors. If you'd like to support the project, consider becoming a sponsor.

🥇 Gold Sponsor

Free version of Qodo for open-source projects

Table of Contents

  • Getting Started
  • Why Use PR-Agent?
  • Features
  • See It in Action
  • How It Works
  • Data Privacy
  • Contributing

Getting Started

Note

Docker Hub namespace migration. Releases 0.34.2 and later are published under pragent/pr-agent. Older releases (up to and including v0.31) remain available at the legacy codiumai/pr-agent namespace as a frozen archive — no new images are pushed there. Update any pinned image: / docker pull / uses: docker:// references when upgrading to 0.34.2+.

🚀 Quick Start for PR-Agent

1. GitHub Action (Recommended)

Add automated PR reviews to your repository with a simple workflow file:

# .github/workflows/pr-agent.yml
name: PR Agent
on:
  pull_request:
    # PR-Agent skips synchronize by default. Include it in github_action_config.pr_actions
    # for auto commands, or enable github_action_config.handle_push_trigger for push_commands (takes precedence).
    types: [opened, synchronize]
jobs:
  pr_agent_job:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
    - name: PR Agent action step
      uses: the-pr-agent/pr-agent@main
      env:
        OPENAI_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_KEY }}
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

Full GitHub Action setup guide

2. CLI Usage (Local Development)

Run PR-Agent locally on your repository:

pip install "pr-agent[github]"
export OPENAI__KEY=your_openai_key
export GITHUB__USER_TOKEN=your_github_token
pr-agent --pr_url https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123 review

Git provider SDKs are optional extras: install the one for your provider (list), or pr-agent[all] for every integration. Complete CLI setup guide

3. Other Platforms

  • GitLab webhook setup
  • BitBucket app installation
  • Azure DevOps setup

News and Updates

Full notes for every release are on the Releases page.

Why Use PR-Agent?

🎯 Built for Real Development Teams

Fast & Affordable: Simple /review and /ask requests can use one LLM call; retries, fallbacks, and larger reviews may need more.

Handles Any PR Size: Our PR Compression strategy effectively processes both small and large PRs

Highly Customizable: JSON-based prompting allows easy customization of review categories and behavior via configuration files

Platform Agnostic:

  • Git Providers: GitHub, GitLab, BitBucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea
  • Deployment: CLI, GitHub Actions, Docker, self-hosted, webhooks
  • AI Models: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, and any other model reachable through LiteLLM (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Databricks, OpenRouter, Ollama, and more) — see Changing a model

Open Source Benefits:

  • Full control over your data and infrastructure
  • Customize prompts and behavior for your team's needs
  • No vendor lock-in
  • Community-driven development

Features

See the current feature and git provider support matrix in the PR-Agent documentation.

⚠️ /help_docs is temporarily disabled since v0.36.1 pending a fix for a credential-exposure issue (#2445).

Usage Examples

PR-Agent commands run as a comment on a PR or from the CLI. A few common ones:

# Comment on a PR (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/…):
/describe
/review
/ask "What does this PR change?" # free-text Q&A about the PR

# Issue-scoped commands run on an issue instead of a PR:
/similar_issue # find similar issues in the repository

# Or locally via the CLI:
pr-agent --pr_url <PR_URL> review
pr-agent --issue_url <ISSUE_URL> similar_issue

See the Commands docs for the full list of commands with example commands, and each command's page for screenshots and options.

aiSummary.oneLiner: The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer powered by AI models.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: PR-Agent is an open-source tool that automates pull request analysis using AI. It provides automated reviews, answers questions about code changes, and suggests improvements. The system integrates with major git providers like GitHub and GitLab. By analyzing the diff, it generates a comprehensive summary and review feedback. This helps development teams maintain high code quality and speeds up the review process.
keyFeatures: Automated review: analyzes pull requests to identify bugs, security issues, and style violations.
Interactive chat: allows developers to ask questions about the PR directly in the comments.
Code suggestions: provides actionable code snippets to improve the submitted changes.
Automatic descriptions: generates comprehensive PR titles and descriptions based on the diff.
Multi-platform integration: supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and other popular git hosting services.

useCases.title: Speed up code reviews
useCases.description: Automate the initial pass of code reviews to catch common issues early.

useCases.title: Improve PR documentation
useCases.description: Generate detailed PR descriptions automatically based on code changes.

useCases.title: Assist developers
useCases.description: Answer questions about complex code changes directly within the PR thread.

useCases.title: Enforce coding standards
useCases.description: Identify style violations and suggest corrections before human review.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Software development teams looking to streamline their code review process. It is particularly useful for organizations dealing with high volumes of pull requests. A basic understanding of git and CI/CD integration is recommended.
